Cladophora is a genus of branching filamentous green algae in the class Ulvophyceae . They may be referred to as reticulated algae , branching algae , [ 2 ] or blanket weed . [ 3 ] The genus has a worldwide distribution, mainly found in marine or brackish waters; a few species are found in freshwater . [ 4 ] It is harvested for use as a food and medicine.
